subject: Life Skills
title: The Savings Rate Matters Most
description: A quick, practical guide to The Savings Rate Matters Most.

hook.text: A person earning $50,000 who saves 30% builds wealth faster than someone earning $150,000 who saves 5%.

buildup.text: Income gets all the attention, but your savings rate — the percentage you keep — determines financial independence.

discovery.text: A 50% savings rate means you can retire in roughly 17 years. A 10% rate takes over 50 years. The math is dramatic.

twist.text: High earners often have the lowest savings rates. Lifestyle inflation eats every raise.

climax.text: When you get a raise, save at least half of the increase before your lifestyle absorbs it. Lock in progress early.

punchline.text: It is not what you earn. It is what you keep.

quiz.question: Why is savings rate more important than income?
options: Saving money is always harder than earning it
The percentage you keep determines wealth-building speed regardless of income
High earners pay more taxes, negating their advantage
